```ts
structural SafeSettings = Proof<Response, "state_isolated" | "no_secret_leakage">;

  const token: string | undefined = apiToken();
  if (token === undefined) {
    return Response.json({ error: "settings unavailable" }, { status: 503 });
  }
  return Response.json({ name: displayName() });

```

Match patterns allow Literal — `undefined` is a Primitive not literal. Pattern: Literal | TypeTestPattern | {fields}. "undefined" is not a literal in grammar (Literal is String | Number | true | false). So match on undefined absence isn't expressible well. Use if.

Risk tradeoff: more properties = more chances for veto, but veto re-prompts cheaply. I'll include the four: deterministic, state_isolated, optional_safe, no_secret_leakage. Actually if aliasing the proof name, maybe name it `structural SettingsResponse = Proof<...>`.
